This step reads the registered frozen inputs. It does not fit models, run bootstrap resampling, call annotations or update the original database. See the [output map](../metadata/result-code-map.tsv) and [reproducibility scope](../docs/reproducibility.md).

```{r}
#| label: params
#| eval: !expr interactive()
#| include: false
params <- list(name = "160-figureS1-ecology")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
wd <- "analyses"
if (basename(getwd()) != wd) setwd(here::here(wd))
here::i_am(paste0(params$name, ".qmd"), uuid = "467629d5-9c69-4289-b151-5ddbf933d388")
qproj::proj_create_dir_target(params$name, clean = FALSE)
path_target <- qproj::proj_path_target(params$name)
path_source <- qproj::proj_path_source(params$name)
path_raw <- path_source("00-raw")
path_resource <- here::here(path_raw, "d00-resource")
path_data <- here::here(path_raw, paste0("d", params$name))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(devtools::load_all())
step <- pc057_step_begin(params$name, path_target, path_resource)
```

## Tasks

```{r}
#| label: run-step
pc057_draw_figure(step, "figS1_ecology")
```

```{r}
#| label: publish-step
receipt <- pc057_step_finish(step)
print(receipt)
```
